_provenance.note: Hand-authored for issue #533 to exercise the THREE outcomes of `normalizeAssignees`, which the existing github-issueList-happy.json cannot: that fixture was trimmed at record time and carries no assignee field on any entry, so every one of its rows is the `null` (cannot see) case. The field shape here was MEASURED against the live endpoint on 2026-08-11 (GET repos/csrinaldi/brain/issues?state=open) rather than taken from the docs: the live payload carries `assignees` as an array of user objects AND a legacy singular `assignee`, and issue #533 itself came back with assignees [{login: csrinaldi}] while #516 came back with []. Entry 901 is the populated case, 902 the read-and-genuinely-empty case, 903 the legacy singular-only case (no plural key — the shape an older GitHub Enterprise Server returns), and 904 the no-assignee-field-at-all case that must normalize to null, not [].
